Fit Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis Model for LTBI and TB Progression

Source: R/evidsynth_fit.R
evidsynth_fit.Rd

Links latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) diagnostic test / survey data with active TB progression data using a parametric mixture cure model in CmdStan. Supports both **published aggregate / surveillance report tables** (cumulative subgroup counts, UKHSA/ETS annual interval counts, and digitized Kaplan-Meier life tables) and **individual-level survival / linked test data**, with imperfect diagnostic tests (`sens`, `spec`) and six modular synthesis strategies (`"joint"`, `"cut"`, `"independent"`, `"melding"`, `"elastic"`, `"tempered"`).

Usage

evidsynth_fit(
  prevalence_data = NULL,
  progression_data,
  model = c("cut", "independent", "joint", "melding", "elastic", "tempered"),
  coupling = c("population", "latent_class"),
  cohort_type = c("all", "pos_only"),
  surv_dist = c("gompertz", "weibull", "exponential"),
  imperfect_test = FALSE,
  covariates = NULL,
  t_horizon = 5,
  priors = list(),
  tau_couple = 0.5,
  w_temper = 0.5,
  t_lim = 20,
  chains = 2,
  n_iter = 1000,
  n_burnin = 500,
  n_thin = 1,
  n_cut_subsamples = 25,
  seed = 123,
  refresh = 0
)

Arguments

prevalence_data

Data frame or tibble of aggregate LTBI survey data (columns `y` or `ltbi`/`n_pos` and `n` or `pop`/`n_migrant`, plus optional `test_id` and covariates) and/or normal logit plug-in summaries (`mu_hat` and `sigma_hat`). Can be `NULL` when `progression_data` already contains group-level LTBI counts (`y` / `ltbi` / `n_pos`) or individual-level test results (`x` / `x1`, `x2`, ...).

progression_data

Data frame or tibble of active TB progression data in one of four formats:

  1. **Published cumulative subgroup summary table:** columns `n` (or `pop` / `n_migrant`), `d` (or `tb` / `n_tb`), optional `y` (or `ltbi` / `n_pos`), optional `t_end` (follow-up duration, defaulting to `t_horizon`), and optional subgroup covariates.

  2. **UKHSA / ETS annual or interval surveillance table:** columns `t_start` (`t0`), `t_end` (`t1`), `d` (`tb` / `n_tb` / `n.event`), and `n` (`pop` / `n_migrant`, initial cohort denominator).

  3. **Published Kaplan-Meier life table:** columns `t_start`/`t_end` (or `time`), `n_risk` (`n.risk`), and `d` (`n.event`).

  4. **Individual-level survival data (IPD):** columns `t` (follow-up time `> 0`) and `d` (`1` = active TB progression, `0` = right-censored), plus optional individual diagnostic test columns (`x` or `x1`, `x2`, ...).

model

Character. Synthesis model strategy:

`"joint"`

Full joint synthesis sharing baseline LTBI prevalence (`alpha_surv = alpha_diag`).

`"cut"`

True two-stage Bayesian cut model (Plummer 2015): fits Stage 1 on the LTBI diagnostic/survey data alone, then propagates posterior draws of prevalence and test accuracy into Stage 2 survival inference with zero feedback from survival to prevalence.

`"independent"`

Disjoint modules with separate independent prevalence parameters `prev_diag` and `prev_cf`.

`"melding"`

Two-stage normal portal approximation (`mu_hat`, `sigma_hat` on `logit(pi)`) combined with the progression survival likelihood.

`"elastic"`

Hierarchical coupling where `logit(prev_cf) ~ Normal(logit(prev_diag), tau_couple)`.

`"tempered"`

Power-likelihood synthesis weighting the progression survival likelihood by `w_temper` in `(0, 1]`.

coupling

Character. How diagnostic test results and progression times are coupled when individual-level linked test data are provided: `"population"` (modular population-level prevalence link) or `"latent_class"` (individual-level marginalization over each person's latent LTBI state `Z_i`).

cohort_type

Character. `"all"` if all screened individuals are followed for progression (uncured fraction is `prev_cf`), or `"pos_only"` if only test-positive individuals are followed (uncured fraction is the positive predictive value, `ppv_cf`).

surv_dist

Character. Parametric uncured survival family: `"gompertz"`, `"weibull"`, or `"exponential"`.

imperfect_test

Logical. If `TRUE`, estimates test sensitivity (`sens`) and specificity (`spec`) with `Beta(a_sens, b_sens)` and `Beta(a_spec, b_spec)` priors. If `FALSE`, fixes them to `sens_fixed` and `spec_fixed`.

covariates

Optional character vector of covariate column names to include in the linear predictor for `logit(pi)`.

t_horizon

Numeric (`> 0`). Default follow-up duration (in years) for published cumulative subgroup summary tables when `t_end` is not explicitly provided as a column. Default is `5`.

priors

Named list of prior hyperparameters overriding defaults (`mu_alpha`, `sigma_alpha`, `sigma_beta`, `mu_shape`, `sigma_shape`, `a_lambda`, `b_lambda`, `a_sens`, `b_sens`, `a_spec`, `b_spec`, `sens_fixed`, `spec_fixed`).

tau_couple

Numeric (`> 0`). Coupling standard deviation on the logit scale when `model = "elastic"`. Default is `0.5`.

w_temper

Numeric in `[0, 1]`. Power-likelihood weight on the survival module when `model = "tempered"`. Default is `0.5`.

t_lim

Integer (`>= 1`). Maximum integer time horizon for posterior predicted survival curves `S_pred[1:t_lim]`. Default is `20`.

chains

Integer. Number of MCMC chains. Default is `2`.

n_iter

Integer. Total iterations per chain (or post-warmup draws + `n_burnin`). Default is `1000`.

n_burnin

Integer. Warmup iterations per chain. Default is `500`.

n_thin

Integer. Thinning interval. Default is `1`.

n_cut_subsamples

Integer. Number of Stage 1 posterior draws to propagate in Stage 2 conditional HMC when `model = "cut"`. Default is `25`.

seed

Optional integer random seed.

refresh

Integer. CmdStan output refresh rate (`0` suppresses progress printing). Default is `0`.

Value

An S3 list object of class `"evidsynth_fit"` containing:

`draws`

A `posterior::draws_df` data frame of posterior samples for `prev_cf`, `prev_diag`, `ppv_cf`, `sens`, `spec`, `lambda`, `shape`, `S_pred[1:t_lim]`, `S_pop_pred[1:t_lim]`, and `log_lik_surv`.

`summary`

Posterior summary table produced by `posterior::summarise_draws()`.

`fit`

Underlying `CmdStanMCMC` object (or Stage 1/2 fit objects for `"cut"`).

`data`

Constructed Stan data list.

`model`

Character name of the synthesis strategy.

`surv_dist`

Character name of the uncured survival distribution.
